{{Top|leg}}
A '''sound-suppression system''' was noise reducing circuitry built into the seating areas of small amphitheaters and arenas to limit the sound waves emanating from the floor of the arena. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], before its destruction, the amphitheater at [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] was equipped with a sound-suppression system.
